p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689839/attempts/999ba5f7203e4d1c9459d496b4c7cec5/system/state/workspace/programs/task-d3215c68.py')

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    ones = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if out[r][c] == 1]
    segments = []
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(ones):
        for r2, c2 in ones[i + 1:]:
            dr, dc = r2 - r1, c2 - c1
            if abs(dr) == abs(dc) and dr != 0:
                sr = 1 if dr > 0 else -1
                sc = 1 if dc > 0 else -1
                pts = [(r1 + k * sr, c1 + k * sc) for k in range(abs(dr) + 1)]
                segments.append(set(pts))
                for r, c in pts:
                    if out[r][c] != 6:
                        out[r][c] = 1
    # A six on a line joining diagonal-aligned ones sends a six diagonal across the grid.
    trigger_sixes = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                     if grid[r][c] == 6 and any((r, c) in seg for seg in segments)]
    for r0, c0 in trigger_sixes:
        for r in range(h):
            c = c0 + (r - r0)
            if 0 <= c < w:
                out[r][c] = 6
    return out
'''
